research.title: Evidence Order Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying retrieved passage order and distractor relevance to examine evidence use in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed answer correctness and citation consistency across experimental conditions, categorizing failures involving conflicting passages, missing evidence, and unsupported synthesis.

research.title: Cross-Domain Calibration of Neural Text Classifiers
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and confidence-based abstention for neural text classifiers under shifts between product review domains.
Analyzed calibration curves and selective prediction errors, separating effects of class imbalance, vocabulary shift, and validation set composition.

publications.title: Calibration and Selective Prediction Under Domain Shift in Product Review Classification

work.title: Support Ticket Processing and Search Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned fixes to support ticket ingestion routines, handling malformed records, duplicate submissions, and inconsistent text encoding.
Maintained keyword search filters and added regression tests for ticket routing behavior, documenting reproducible failures for code review.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented probabilistic lexical and pretrained sentence embedding retrieval baselines using shared document preprocessing and query evaluation procedures.
Compared ranking quality and retrieval latency, inspecting queries with rare terminology, paraphrased wording, and ambiguous document matches.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling Approaches to Named Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field baseline and fine-tuned a transformer token classifier using consistent entity labels and data splits.
Compared span-level precision and recall, categorizing boundary errors, entity type confusions, and failures on previously unseen names.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Graph and Centroid Ranking
bullets: Implemented graph-based sentence ranking and centroid-based extraction for news summarization, applying identical sentence segmentation and summary length constraints.
Compared summaries using lexical overlap metrics and manual checks for redundancy, topical coverage, and references lacking antecedents.
